name: A Feiticeira
source:
When Tenente Sousa mocks old stories of witches and curses, he sets in motion a nightmare. Trapped in the unforgiving forest of Paranamiri, he must fight for his life against a power older than time itself.

[From [url=https://seitadracula.itch.io/a-feiticeira]Itch.io[/url]]
